review.assessment: This change introduces a new src/lib.rs containing only a stub implementation of int_to_roman that ignores its input and immediately returns an empty string. Because the conversion algorithm is left as a TODO, every test case currently produces an empty result instead of valid Roman numerals. The repository therefore lacks any working logic for the required 1–3999 range.

findings.defect: Stub implementation returns an empty string instead of processing the input
Same stub behavior fails for compound values
